column:office_schedule_versions.updated_: timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
column:office_schedules.updated_at: timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraint:office_schedules.office_sched: CHECK ((((closes_for_lunch = false) AND (lunch_start IS NULL) AND (lunch_end IS NULL)) OR ((closes_for_lunch = true) AND (is_working = true) AND (lunch_start ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'::text) AND (lunch_end ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'::text) AND (lunch_start >= opens_at) AND (lunch_end <= closes_at) AND (lunch_end > lunch_start))))

CHECK ((((is_working = false) AND (opens_at IS NULL) AND (closes_at IS NULL)) OR ((is_working = true) AND (opens_at ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'::text) AND (closes_at ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'::text) AND (closes_at > opens_at))))
index:office_schedule_versions.office_sc: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX office_schedule_versions_pkey ON public.office_schedule_versions USING btree (office_id)
index:office_schedules.office_schedules_: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX office_schedules_pkey ON public.office_schedules USING btree (office_id, weekday)
